name: Boon of Terror

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Immune to Frightened, with Expertise in Intimidation; once per rest, a Frightened creature you can see starting its turn near you must save or flee.

benefits.name: Fearless and Intimidating
benefits.summary: Immune to Frightened; Intimidation proficiency and Expertise.
benefits.text: Immune to Frightened; Intimidation proficiency and Expertise.

benefits.name: Paralyzing Dread
benefits.summary: Reaction, once per Short or Long Rest: a Frightened creature starting its turn within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or spends its turn fleeing you.
benefits.text: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you starts its turn Frightened and without Total Cover from you, you can take a Reaction to make it make a Wisdom saving throw against 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. On a failure it spends that turn moving away from you by the fastest means it has. Once per Short or Long Rest; it's used on its own unless you turn it Off in the class tab.
benefits.policy_cost: A Reaction, once per Short or Long Rest
